datasets.name: Bijie Landslide Dataset
datasets.verbatim: Bijie Landslide Dataset: The triple sat satellite took 2773 RSIs between May and August 2018 at a ground resolution of 0.8 m, forming the Bijie landslide dataset [9].

datasets.name: Turkey Earthquake 23 Dataset
datasets.verbatim: The HGM KURE program provides satellite and autonomous drone images of earthquake zones. The HGM KURE application’s screenshots were used to acquire the images of earthquake-damaged buildings within the area covered by the dataset.

datasets.name: MLRSNet Dataset
datasets.verbatim: MLRSNet Dataset: The MLRSNet for semantic scenes consists of HR optical satellite or aerial images with multilabels [17], as shown in Fig. 2.

methods.name: FMANet (Super-Resolution Inverted Bottleneck-Fused Self-Attention Architecture)
methods.summary: FMANet is a convolutional neural network architecture that integrates a custom deep super-resolution network for image quality enhancement, followed by a fused bottleneck self-attention architecture that learns features through residual and inverted networks. The model uses network-level fusion via depthwise concatenation and a self-attention layer, with hyperparameters optimized via Bayesian optimization, and classifies features using a shallow narrow neural network (SN3).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom FMANet code repository is not provided.
